description: Authentication layer (subscription-first, API-fallback). Create nightshift/auth.sh that resolves per-adapter auth subscription-first. Replace evaluate.py's metered Anthropic SDK call (from anthropic import Anthropic) with a shell-out to `claude -p --output-format json` with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY UNSET (Max credit pool). Ensure codex is authed via Sign-in-with-ChatGPT, not OPENAI_API_KEY. Change init.sh to stop exiting on missing OPENAI_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; instead verify subscription CLIs (claude, codex) are logged in; treat API keys as optional fallback only. When a subscription path returns a rate-limit signal, auth.sh may re-enable the metered key for that call ONLY if auth.fallback_api=true, recording spend in state/budget.json. Use official CLIs only — never 3rd-party auth plugins. PROTECTED PATH (secrets): requires explicit approval; never commit key material.

description: Add guardrails to the supervisor: daily ($20) and per-run ($5) metered-fallback cost ceilings from config (ledger state/budget.json); circuit breaker OPEN on 3 no-progress iterations, 5 repeated identical errors, any permission-denial, or subscription-pool exhausted; hourly call cap.
